map.原油贸易与计价：不同产区原油以 API 度报价，需换算为比重(SG)与密度(g/: Crude trading and pricing: crudes from different producing regions are quoted by API gravity and must be converted to specific gravity (SG) and density (g/cm³, kg/m³) before mass, volume and shipping stowage can be calculated; the tool converts between API and SG, so entering either one gives the other.
map.炼厂装置设计与混兑：原油调和时要按密度核算混合油比重，API 度越高表示越轻、经: Refinery unit design and blending: when blending crudes the mixed specific gravity is checked against density; a higher API gravity means a lighter crude and usually higher economic value. The classify step quickly identifies light / medium / heavy / extra-heavy.
map.实验室与计量交接：交接计量常以 60°F(15.6℃) 标准密度为准，本工具以: Laboratory work and custody transfer: custody transfer usually uses the standard density at 60 °F (15.6 °C). This tool converts density against a 60 °F water relative density of 1.0, making it easy to compare with measurement tickets.
map.算例：API 度换算为相对密度与类别: Worked example: converting API gravity to relative density and grade
map.API=30 时 SG = 141.5/(30+131.5) = 0.8762，:
At API = 30, SG = 141.5/(30+131.5) = 0.8762, density (water = 1.0) = 0.8762 g/cm³ = 876.2 kg/m³; classify(30): 22.3 ≤ 30 ≤ 31.1 → medium crude.
At API = 35, SG = 141.5/166.5 = 0.8498, density 0.8498 g/cm³, classify(35) > 31.1 → light crude.
Back-calculation: SG = 0.85 → API = 141.5/0.85 − 131.5 = 34.97 °API (light). Classification thresholds: >31.1 light, ≥22.3 medium, ≥10 heavy, <10 extra-heavy / bitumen.
map.API 度是美国石油学会的相对密度标度：°API = 141.5/SG - 13: API gravity is the American Petroleum Institute relative-density scale: °API = 141.5/SG − 131.5, where SG is the relative density at 60 °F. The larger the value, the lighter the oil; at °API = 10, SG = 1.0 (the same weight as water) — above 10 the oil is lighter than water, below 10 it is heavier.
map.原油轻重如何分类？: How is crude classified by weight?
Common cut-offs: API > 31.1 light crude, 22.3–31.1 medium, 10–22.3 heavy, < 10 extra-heavy or bitumen. Light crudes are easier to refine into high-value fractions and usually carry a premium.
map.比重 SG = 141.5 ÷ (API 度 + 131.5)；密度(g/cm³: Specific gravity SG = 141.5 ÷ (API gravity + 131.5); density (g/cm³) = SG × density of water at the same temperature, density (kg/m³) = the former × 1000. Validation: prompt for an API gravity when empty; at ≤ −131.5 the denominator is non-positive, so prompt that it must be greater than −131.5. Crude classification: API > 31.1 light crude, ≥ 22.3 medium crude, ≥ 10 heavy crude, < 10 extra-heavy / bitumen

SG = 141.5 ÷ (API + 131.5); density (g/cm³) = SG × pure-water density at the selected temperature; density (kg/m³) = the former × 1000. API and SG are defined as relative densities at 60°F (15.6°C); this page does not convert other temperatures to 60°F. Validation: blank API or API ≤ −131.5 prompts; SG and selected water density must be finite positive values. Crude classification: API > 31.1 light, ≥ 22.3 medium, ≥ 10 heavy, < 10 extra-heavy/bitumen.
map.API↔SG 换算时，明确两者均按 60°F（15.6℃）相对密度定义；其他温度: When converting API↔SG, both are defined as relative densities at 60°F (15.6°C); values measured at other temperatures must first be converted to that basis.
map.使用所选水温的纯水密度；水密度缺失或非正时清除结果，不把无效值乘进去。: The density uses pure-water density at the selected temperature; if water density is missing or non-positive, the result is cleared instead of multiplying by an invalid value.
map.本页不做温度修正；若用户在其他温度测量，结果仅为近似，不可暗示已完成修正。: This page does not perform temperature correction; measurements at other temperatures give approximate results only and must not be presented as corrected.
